customers_say: Customers find the door lock easy to install, with one noting it fits perfectly on wooden door frames, and appreciate its reliable performance with triple deadlocks for high security. The product offers multiple unlocking options and customers like its appearance, adding a modern touch to their doors. While the app interface is good and easy to use, some customers report a terrible experience with the app.

reviews.author: Sree
reviews.title: Installation Service - not prompt. Product returned.
reviews.body: Installation support is poor ( was scheduled twice and no show for both occasions ) and finally had to return the item. Item build quality is okay. It runs on AA batteries. Customer support is responsive, but unable to handle their installation partners effectively.

reviews.author: SOURAV SHARMA
reviews.title: NATIVE LOCK PRO
reviews.body: Good product sturdy and having simple interface, Mr. Arjun installation person has full knowledge and experience.. Great experience for us.

reviews.author: Asit kumar Subudhi
reviews.title: Thank you UC and Amazon for this amazing Door lock.
reviews.body: A must buy product. Fully satisfied. Easy to install and use. Provides full security to your entry and also easyvto control the access through app. A value for money product. A little bit desatisfied with the delay in installation bur rest okay.

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Professional technician
reviews.body: Great experience with the Urban Company Native lock installation. The technician was extremely professional, skilled, and handled the door fitting with neat precision. He also took the time to explain how the smart lock functions, set up the app, and cleared all the drilling mess after finishing the job. 5/5 stars!
